results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article discussing a study by sociologist Fabio Giglietto regarding how Meta's algorithms impact voting and democracy. The study, titled "A Pretty Blunt Approach," shows how Meta's policy of reducing political content inadvertently restricted the reach of mainstream political officials while boosting the visibility of extremist groups. His findings sparked a debate that led to a feature on the television show 'Report' on Rai3 and an inquiry in the European Parliament.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: An official university press feature outlining how Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic visibility limitations was featured on Rai3's investigative journalism show 'Report' on April 12, 2026. The coverage highlights how his research prompted European parliamentarians to submit a formal inquiry to the European Commission regarding Meta's compliance with the Digital Services Act.
